name: jig
description: Make Instagram carousels, reels, video ads and story shorts just by asking.

interface.shortDescription: Posts, reels and shorts from one message
interface.longDescription: Connects Jig's tools (feed drafts, image/video/TTS generation, layered editing, rendering) and installs Jig's production skills for carousels, card news, reels, issue shorts and video ads. You sign in with your Jig account during install.
defaultPrompt: Make a 6-slide carousel comparing three iced coffees
Turn this topic into a 45-second narrated short
Make a 15-second vertical ad for this product
